title: Validate dynamic request lookup and evidence coverage
objective: Run the complete provider-free matrix, package gates, documentation checks, scope audit, and non-goal review for dynamic request lookup. Contract sections: requests/README.md#work-item-validation-gates; requests/README.md#evidence-boundary. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.
